senses.gloss: m. (sacrarium) shrine in a temple or in a house.
units: Gen. R. s. 89 שכך מוכתב בס׳ וכ׳ (ed. סקרידין, סקרירין) for thus is it recorded in the aerarium of the Pharaoh that a slave cannot obtain an office &c. (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Aerarium); Yalk. ib. 147 בסיקררין שלהם; (Tanḥ. Mick. 3 בספריו).
